about: Say hello. The model fails with a server error, the harness retries once and the turn fails.

known.reason: Mako sums up the retries it watched on the wire (Grok's `retry_state` updates) in one marker, measured by the frames' clock; the store keeps each retry's update, never Mako's measure, so only the live drawing has it (RETRY_MARKERS, declared stream-only).
